# Arc Signage Co
> Full-service sign company for New York and the Tri-State area (NYC five boroughs, all of NJ and CT): signage design, shop drawings, fabrication, and permit and install coordination. Arc coordinates with Licensed Sign Hangers, licensed electricians, engineers or architects, and expediters where required; it does not file permits or stamp drawings. For a storefront sign, lit letters included, photos with measurements are enough to start a quote. Intake: arc@arcsignco.com, (347) 450-2110.

## Services
- [Sign permits & shop drawings](https://arcsignco.com/sign-permits-shop-drawings/): when NYC signs need a DOB permit, who files, who installs, and what shop drawings include.
- [ADA & tactile signs](https://arcsignco.com/ada-signs/): room, restroom, stair, and exit signs with tactile text and Grade 2 Braille.
- [Channel letters](https://arcsignco.com/channel-letters/): front-lit, halo-lit, and reverse LED letters; permits and electrical coordination.
- [Construction site signs](https://arcsignco.com/construction-signs/): NYC project information panels, sidewalk shed panels, and safety and directional signs; fence/shed graphics rules.
